references.text: God's assurance of his presence and protection, similar to the encouragement Jesus gives in Mark 6:50.
Jesus uses the same words 'Be encouraged, it is I; do not be afraid' with the disciples on the sea, as in Mark 6:50.
Jesus comforts the disciples with similar words in another situation, showing his constant presence and encouragement.
Jesus uses similar words to encourage his disciples, demonstrating a pattern of his care and assurance.
